_comment: Ids dossiq reserved in the parity corpus (ConductionNL/market-intelligence, procest/_round4/tools/corpus-rows.json) on 2026-10-07, decisions 79 and 82. Each is the next free number in its area across rows and proposals in this repo. scripts/sync-capability-comparison.mjs re-issues capabilities.json from the corpus and drops any row the corpus does not hold, so the corpus has to issue these rows under these ids, with these texts and our rating, before the next re-issue; until then a re-issue removes them and tests/vitest/capabilityComparison.spec.js fails on the row count. Competitor cells are unread.

rows.cap: Register and handle complaints under Awb chapter 9 with deadlines, hearing and disposition
rows.cap_nl: Klachten registreren en afhandelen volgens Awb hoofdstuk 9 met termijnen, hoorzitting en afdoening
rows.dossiqNote: Rated no rather than the partial the reader proposed: the backend is complete and nothing a user can open reaches it, which is the rule this file applied to fourteen rows on 2026-09-25. Missing: a complaint page or case-type entry that starts and works a complaint.

rows.cap: Run tenders from publication through evaluation, award and contract management
rows.cap_nl: Aanbestedingen voeren van publicatie via beoordeling en gunning tot contractbeheer
rows.dossiqNote: Partial covers suppliers and the contract hand-offs only; the tender suite itself (publication, bids, evaluation, award) is not built. Missing: tenders, bids, evaluation, award, eForms/TED, thresholds and supplier pages.

rows.cap: Request advice and consultations on a case and track the responses and deadlines
rows.cap_nl: Advies en consultatie op een zaak aanvragen en de reacties en termijnen bewaken
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: a place on the case to request advice or a consultation and to read the answers (the advice and consultations tabs the queue links to). Pending proposal 3.32 covers outside advice.

rows.cap: Work the personal case queue in order of urgency and deadline, with a team workload summary
rows.cap_nl: De persoonlijke werkvoorraad afwerken op volgorde van urgentie en termijn, met een overzicht van de teambelasting
rows.dossiqNote: The open change one-personal-queue widens what feeds the queue; ordering and the workload summary are built.

rows.cap: Suppliers sign in to see their own tenders, contracts and messages
rows.cap_nl: Leveranciers loggen in en zien hun eigen aanbestedingen, contracten en berichten
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: the contract endpoints the supplier pages read (ContractController in supplier-portal), and with them a supplier's own contracts.

rows.cap: Pick an enforcement intervention from the national enforcement strategy matrix and record overrides
rows.cap_nl: Een handhavingsinterventie kiezen uit de Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie en afwijkingen vastleggen
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: the enforcement panel or wizard on a handhaving case that asks for a recommendation and records an override.

rows.cap: Register a notice of default, accrue the statutory penalty and signal the payout to finance
rows.cap_nl: Ingebrekestelling registreren, dwangsom opbouwen en uitbetaling aan financiën doorgeven
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: registering the notice of default from the case, and the payout signal to finance.

rows.cap: Report case costs per Iv3 taakveld, with 2023 refinement codes rolled up to their parent
rows.cap_nl: Zaakkosten rapporteren per Iv3-taakveld, met de verfijningscodes van 2023 samengevoegd onder hun hoofdcode
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: the quarterly aggregation (Iv3ReportService) and a page or export that reports costs per taakveld.

rows.cap: Run permit, supervision and enforcement cases from seeded VTH case types and workflows
rows.cap_nl: Vergunning-, toezicht- en handhavingszaken afhandelen met ingerichte VTH-zaaktypen en workflows
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: the VTH admin page (workflows, leges, beschikking templates, DSO), placing the VTH panels on the case, and callers for the VTH template and DSO intake.

rows.cap: Get guided through first-time setup, including loading demo data
rows.cap_nl: Bij de eerste ingebruikname door de inrichting geleid worden, inclusief het laden van demodata
rows.dossiqNote: Rated yes. It would read partial if the requirement that the wizard waits until the register is ready is held to. The open change wizard-dataset-card-load folds the demo data choice and its load into one step.

rows.cap: Share or transfer a case to another Nextcloud instance and follow its shared activity
rows.cap_nl: Een zaak delen met of overdragen aan een andere Nextcloud-omgeving en de gedeelde activiteit volgen
rows.dossiqNote: Built on openregister's federation leaf; without it sharing fails closed.

rows.cap: Handle Wmo, Jeugdwet and Participatiewet cases with consent and special-category data safeguards
rows.cap_nl: Wmo-, Jeugdwet- en Participatiewetzaken behandelen met toestemming en waarborgen voor bijzondere persoonsgegevens
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: the consent and classification UI, wijkteam-only access, seeded Wmo, Jeugdwet and Participatiewet case types, and the anonymised export.

rows.cap: Process grants from application through advances to final settlement
rows.cap_nl: Subsidies verwerken van aanvraag via voorschotten tot vaststelling
rows.dossiqNote: Rated no rather than the partial the reader proposed: nothing a user opens reaches the subsidy backend (same rule as the 2026-09-25 rows). subsidie-settlement-case-costs contradicts ADR-081 and needs a decision before it is built.

rows.cap: Carry out inspections with checklists and photos in the field, also without a connection
rows.cap_nl: Inspecties met checklists en foto's in het veld uitvoeren, ook zonder verbinding
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: an inspection panel on the case that fills a checklist, takes photos and submits the result, and the offline path that feeds the sync queue. Pending proposal 16.1 covers offline.

rows.cap: Run several tenants with a lifecycle, quotas, billing, onboarding and mandate checks
rows.cap_nl: Meerdere tenants beheren met levenscyclus, quota, facturatie, onboarding en mandaatcontrole
rows.dossiqNote: Missing: wiring provision and usage, enforcing quotas, and a billing view.
